clause: Non-destructive effect model core: StudioEffectStack + StudioLiveFilter entry structure [STU-FX-001,STU-FX-002,STU-FX-003,STU-FX-005,STU-FX-006,STU-FX-006b]
summary: Implement the single non-destructive effect model on the canonical primitives StudioEffectStack (hsk.studio.effect_stack@1) + StudioLiveFilter: ordered re-editable/reorderable/enable-disable entries each carrying filter_kind (catalog key), typed parameter payload, StudioBlendMode+opacity, enabled flag, render_scope (layer|below|group), valid layer targets (R/V/T/G). Source raster tiles / vector network / text story preserved unchanged; result composed at render time by RenderEngine. No per-suite variant; no per-kind instance cap. Deduplicates smart-filter stack + live-filter layer + appearance stack + layer-effect panel into one model. Never fork the primitives (fields canonical in 14.23).
expected_tests: cargo test studio::effects::stack
test: entry reorder re-composes deterministically; delete restores exact prior result (no quality loss)
test: source data unchanged after apply (non-destructive); render_scope layer|below|group honored
test: no per-kind instance cap; layer-target R/V/T/G enforced
risk_if_missed: No non-destructive stack; every 14.9 family MT blocked or forks its own model.
acceptance: StudioEffectStack+StudioLiveFilter compile on canonical primitives; non-destructive re-editable reorderable entries; render_scope + R/V/T/G targets; no fork

clause: Effect masking, selection-scoping + color-managed / bit-depth evaluation [STU-FX-004,STU-FX-006a,STU-FX-010,STU-FX-012a]
summary: Give each StudioLiveFilter entry its own optional StudioMask (raster mask / vector clip / gradient mask), applied only where opaque with the mask's feather; selection-scoping so a live StudioSelectionSet is captured as the entry's effect-region mask (one deduped rule, no separate filter-selection vs filter-layer mode). Enforce typed unit-bearing parameters (radii/offsets in document px, angles in degrees, color params carry explicit StudioColorProfile); evaluate in the layer's declared working space at 8/16/32-bit; descriptor declares supported depths rather than silently degrading.

risk_if_missed: Effects unmaskable / device-color-unsafe; wrong output outside 8-bit.
acceptance: per-entry StudioMask + selection-scope capture; typed unit-bearing params; 8/16/32-bit color-managed eval; declared supported depths

clause: Effect command surface + STUDIO_EFFECT_* events + gated lifecycle [STU-FX-007,STU-FX-008,STU-FX-009,STU-FX-011a]
summary: Implement the model-steerable typed effect commands STUDIO_EFFECT_APPLY / _UPDATE / _REORDER / _TOGGLE / _REMOVE / _MASK_EDIT / _BAKE on event_family=studio.effect, each routed sandbox -> StudioValidationDescriptor -> PromotionGate (never a direct authority write). Blend-options fold into the standard StudioBlendMode+opacity surface (no separate fade command). Repeat-last-effect + repeat-with-new-settings as ONE deduped command. Effect on placed_asset/smart-object applies to the rendered proxy; convert-for-filters collapses to a no-op (layers are filter-hosting by default).

live: model effect mutation blocked from direct authority write (sandbox->validation->promotion)

risk_if_missed: No model-steerable effect API; effect mutations bypass validation/promotion.
proof_targets: command-contract + fail-closed direct-write negative + event-registration test
acceptance: 7 STUDIO_EFFECT_* commands+events gated through promotion; deduped fade into blend; single repeat-last; smart-object proxy apply

acceptance: deterministic seeded eval; tiled ROI re-render; preview==final; every mutation reversible history entry; adjustment/filter one order

proof_targets: real-GPU render + headless EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE fallback + quiet negative test
acceptance: RenderEngine/StudioRenderHarness binding; GPU-Req -> determinate unavailable state; Opt CPU fallback equivalent; GPU dep isolated; headless+quiet

Raster-group vector effects (artistic/blur applied to vector art) render through the document raster-effect resolution setting and REUSE the group-10 catalog (no redefinition). Vector Stylize = the round-corners + scribble native-vector kinds plus the shadow/glow/feather layer-fx reused from MT-287/288 evaluated on live geometry (NOT the raster Stylize family of MT-275).
expected_tests: cargo test studio::effects::vector::eval
test: effect re-evaluates on geometry edit; EFFECT_BAKE expands to real geometry; raster-on-vector uses doc raster-effect resolution
test: vector Stylize reuses layer-fx kinds (no fork of raster Stylize)
risk_if_missed: Vector effects pre-rasterize / fork; live-geometry re-eval + bake-expand missing.
acceptance: vector live-effect eval on live geometry + EFFECT_BAKE expand; Stylize = round corners/scribble/shadow/glow/feather reused; raster-on-vector reuses group-10

summary: Implement the vector 3D-and-materials live effects (V,T,G): Extrude & Bevel (depth/cap/bevel shape+width/rotation), Revolve (profile around vertical axis, angle/offset/cap), Inflate (puffed 3D volume), 3D Rotate (plane effect, no depth), Materials (parametric materials + custom graphics on 3D surfaces; community material assets provider-optional per group 16), 3D Lighting (multiple lights: intensity/rotation/height/softness/ambient/shadow), Ray-Traced Render (GPU ray-traced quality settings before export/expand), 3D (Classic) legacy engine (Opt). Geometric extrude/revolve/inflate primitives are native; materials/ray-trace GPU-required with real-GPU proof + headless fallback.
expected_tests: real-GPU: Extrude&Bevel/Revolve/Inflate/3D Rotate + Materials + 3D Lighting + Ray-Traced render
headless: EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE fallback; native extrude/revolve/inflate geometry without materials
test: community materials provider-optional (EFFECT_ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE when absent)
risk_if_missed: Vector 3D/materials/ray-trace missing; parametric 3D unavailable.
acceptance: Extrude & Bevel, Revolve, Inflate, 3D Rotate, Materials, 3D Lighting, Ray-Traced Render, 3D (Classic); GPU proof + headless; materials provider-optional

summary: Implement the vector Distort & Transform live effects (V,T,G; CPU/No-GPU): Free Distort (four corner-point frame), Pucker & Bloat (anchor pull outward/inward, segments curve opposite), Roughen (jagged peaks/valleys, size/detail/smooth-corner), Transform step-repeat (live move/scale/rotate/reflect + copies count for procedural step-and-repeat stacks), Tweak (random segment curve/distort, relative/absolute), Twist (sharper rotation at center), Zig Zag vector (uniform jagged/wavy arrays, size/ridges/point-type). expected_tests: cargo test studio::effects::vector::distort_transform
test: Transform copies-count step-repeat stack; Pucker&Bloat/Roughen/Tweak/Twist/ZigZag geometry correctness; bake-expand
risk_if_missed: Vector distort/transform + step-repeat live effects missing.
acceptance: Free Distort, Pucker & Bloat, Roughen, Transform (step-repeat), Tweak, Twist, Zig Zag (vector)

summary: Implement the live Pathfinder appearance effects (V,G; non-destructive until expanded, reusing the 14.5 boolean core - NOT a fork): Add/union, Intersect, Exclude, Subtract (front from back), Minus Back (back from front), Divide (independent faces at intersections), Trim (remove hidden filled parts, discard strokes), Merge (trim + merge adjacent same-color faces), Crop (to frontmost outline), Outline/edges (unfilled edge segments), Hard Mix (highest CMYK component), Soft Mix (mixing-rate percentage), Trap (print traps: thickness, tint reduction). test: live boolean ops reuse 14.5 boolean core (no reimplementation); non-destructive until expand; Trap/Hard Mix/Soft Mix print-composite correctness
risk_if_missed: Live pathfinder-as-effect missing; boolean core forked.
acceptance: Add, Intersect, Exclude, Subtract, Minus Back, Divide, Trim, Merge, Crop, Outline, Hard Mix, Soft Mix, Trap; reuse 14.5 boolean core

clause: Cross-backend promotion-equivalence golden coverage for every effect row [STU-FX-037]
summary: Assert every 14.9 catalog effect row is covered by the 14.24 golden-image validation set: for a given effect kind+params+seed+StudioColorProfile output is byte-stable on a fixed backend and within declared promotion-equivalence tolerance across backends (CPU fallback, Vulkan, Metal, DX12, WebGPU); an effect whose backends disagree beyond tolerance FAILS validation and cannot be promoted. Coverage check enumerates all implemented effect_kind and fails if any lacks a golden entry.
expected_tests: multi-backend: sample effects byte-stable per backend + within tolerance across CPU/Vulkan/Metal/DX12/WebGPU
test: coverage check fails if any implemented effect_kind lacks a 14.24 golden entry
negative: out-of-tolerance effect blocked from promotion
risk_if_missed: Backends silently diverge; effects promoted with non-equivalent output.
acceptance: every effect row covered by 14.24 golden set; byte-stable per backend + tolerance across backends; out-of-tolerance blocks promotion

summary: Implement effect styles + presets on the StudioStyleRegistry: a StudioEffectStack (or any sub-range) savable as a named reusable effect style (live reference - updating the style updates every applying layer), publishable across documents, deduping effect-styles/graphic-styles/saved-filter-presets into one primitive; per-filter/gallery/lighting/warp parameter sets savable as presets through the same registry; applying an effect style is a typed command through the propose-work lifecycle (14.18). Preset assets (textures, displacement maps, custom kernels, material graphs) referenced via document-relative/configured asset roots - NO absolute/machine-local paths (portability posture). Operator-visible styles picker.
expected_tests: test: effect style live reference (update style -> updates all applying layers); per-filter/gallery/lighting/warp presets savable; apply via propose-work
test: preset assets referenced via document-relative/configured roots (no absolute path); portability move test
argus: styles picker reachable stable author_ids
risk_if_missed: No reusable effect styles/presets; effect library non-portable.
acceptance: effect styles (live reference) + per-filter/gallery/lighting/warp presets on StudioStyleRegistry; portable asset refs; operator-visible picker

summary: OPTIONAL adapter lane framework: expose generative/ML filters as StudioLiveFilter entries whose filter_kind binds to a StudioModelAdapter (14.23); when no adapter is configured the effect surfaces a determinate EFFECT_ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE result (never a silent no-op); a local downloadable model and a cloud provider are the SAME effect kind with different adapter bindings. Adapter output MUST land as a non-destructive stack entry or a new masked layer (current / new / masked / new document) selectable by operator/model, never overwriting source; provider calls obey the headless/quiet law (bounded, observable, attributable, no foreground popup). Includes the ML Filter lane workspace host. MARK optional; not required for Studio parity.
expected_tests: test: no adapter configured -> EFFECT_ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE (not silent no-op); same effect_kind binds local vs cloud adapter
test: adapter output lands as non-destructive entry / new masked layer (never overwrites source); quiet (no popup, bounded, attributable)
risk_if_missed: Generative filters silently no-op or overwrite source; optional lane unsafe.
proof_targets: adapter-unavailable determinate state + non-destructive landing + quiet test
acceptance: OPTIONAL adapter lane: StudioModelAdapter binding, EFFECT_ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE, local==cloud effect kind, non-destructive output landing, headless/quiet; ML Filter lane workspace host
